column1: # jespersen's own Russian word list (CC0), written from the standard language: the stress of words
# and word forms the rules would miss. One entry per line:
# - a word or word form with an acute accent (U+0301) after its stressed vowel (молоко́); ё is
#   always stressed, and a word of one vowel needs no mark;
# - or a stem, ending in "-" when its endings keep the stress where it is marked (кни́г-), or in
#   "+" when they take it (стол+: стола́, столу́), then the class whose endings it takes: n for
#   nouns, a for adjectives, v for verbs (кни́г-n, стол+n);
# - after a tab, a respelling for a word said otherwise than written (что → што).
# Listed forms come before stems, and a prefix (по-, при-, рас-…) may stand before any of them.
